verdict.rationale: Patent Center documents direct, versioned API calls against its Workbench and view-applications surfaces. Probes confirm a live api.uspto.gov endpoint using an API-key model and a developer portal, so a public API exists. The documented scope appears limited to viewing applications, and the portal's docs only render after JavaScript runs. Missing for 10: evidence that filing, payment or other core actions can be driven via API, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), API docs readable without JavaScript, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving workflows end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications.
a real machine endpoint that answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge: an API-key model, not a bot wall.
